body.statement: If Open-ended Question \(\mathrm{oeq:uniform\text{-}generated\text{-}residual\text{-}expansion}\) is resolved affirmatively for \(\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{LP}}\), \(\mathcal G_n(x;C_m,\widehat m)\), and the constant \(c_u\), then for the unique \(\widehat m\in\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{LP}}\) and every \(n\) satisfying \(u_{d,\alpha}=\log(8/\alpha)+\log(2d)\le c_u n\), \(\widehat{\mathcal C}_n(\widehat m)\) is measurable, uses exactly \(2d\) residual-HSIC queries and \(2d\) conditional-risk queries, and satisfies \[\inf_{(P,\theta)\in\mathcal M_d(\lambda)}P^{\otimes n}\{\theta\in\widehat{\mathcal C}_n(\widehat m)\}\ge1-\alpha.\] For the constants \(c_r,C\) in Theorem \(\mathrm{thm:uniform\text{-}minimax\text{-}frontier}\), if in addition \(n\lambda\ge C\log((d+1)/\alpha)\) and \(r_n^4\le c_r\lambda\), then \[\inf_{(P,\theta)\in\mathcal M_d(\lambda)}P^{\otimes n}\{\widehat{\mathcal C}_n(\widehat m)=\{\theta\}\}\ge1-\alpha.\] Its kernel-matrix cost is \(O(dn^2)\), and Theorem \(\mathrm{thm:product\text{-}testing\text{-}converse}\) prevents uniformly honest sets from collapsing earlier by more than constants.
body.justification: The confidence set converts the conditional rate theorem into a computable uncertainty object using the same fixed nuisance class and joint regression event, and aligns singleton output with the minimax transition.
body.gap: Wang, Kolar, and Drton (2026) give asymptotically valid ordering sets through residual bootstrap, not a finite-sample uniform \(O(d)\)-query product set with a matching singleton converse.
body.consumer: Applied analysts can report every pair-orientation vector not rejected by the data instead of a single overconfident graph.
